summary: Hallador Energy's wholly owned subsidiary Hallador Power entered a six-year Power Purchase Agreement with Duke Energy Indiana on October 7, 2026, covering an annual average 200 MW from the Merom Generating Station from June 1, 2029 through May 31, 2035. Separately, under the Master Power Purchase and Sale Agreement, Hallador Power will sell 225 Zonal Resource Credits daily for roughly $271 million over the same term. Both are commercial energy contracts requiring standby letters of credit; no equity, control, or special-situation event is present. Watch counterparty and collateral obligations.
